scripts.check: npm run check:home && npm run check:docs
scripts.build:docs: cd .. && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=.venv-docs uv run --locked --group docs --no-default-groups python scripts/docs_site.py build
scripts.check:home: wrangler types && tsc --noEmit && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.check:docs: wrangler types --config ../docs/hosting/wrangler.jsonc ../docs/hosting/worker-configuration.d.ts --env-interface DocsEnv && tsc --project ../docs/hosting/tsconfig.json && vitest run --config vitest.docs.config.ts
